title: 代际提升判定
acceptance: 植入信号能被判 VERIFIED；无信号时 VERIFIED 率≤5%

ddl.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS r27_generation(generation INTEGER NOT NULL,loop TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MAIN',dataset_hash TEXT NOT NULL,births INTEGER NOT NULL,rejected INTEGER NOT NULL,no_op INTEGER NOT NULL,duplicates INTEGER NOT NULL,survivors INTEGER NOT NULL,retired INTEGER NOT NULL,champion_hash TEXT,champion_select_u REAL,champion_holdout_hr REAL,prev_champion_holdout_hr REAL,null_champion_holdout_hr REAL,i00_champion_holdout_hr REAL,paired_lcb REAL,verified INTEGER NOT NULL,detail_json TEXT NOT NULL,started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,finished_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(loop,generation))

statusRule: HOST/CI → 已修改待设备验证 at most; 已验证 only with real-device evidence
